title: Annadaan Mahadaan
summary: On 18th October, a food distribution drive was organised at Juhu Park, behind the “I Love Mumbai” board, with the generous support of donor Poonam Atul Singhania.
description: On 18th October, a food distribution drive was organised at Juhu Park, behind the “I Love Mumbai” board, with the generous support of donor Poonam Atul Singhania. The initiative aimed to share the joy and festive spirit with underprivileged children by providing them with food and spreading happiness. A beautiful gesture of kindness, compassion and togetherness!
